title: Folkets Biodiversitetsmarch in Copenhagen
scope: Single described Copenhagen march; no nationwide aggregation asserted.
organizer: Coalition of environmental organizations and participants; post-event report names several groups.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established by any body-read source. Organizer search-result preview claims >5,000 but body request failed and that figure remains search-only.

start_date.summary: Post-event report explicitly says groups and individuals gathered in Copenhagen on 3 June.

end_date.summary: No end date/time given in the body-read report.

location.summary: Post-event report locates the march in Copenhagen; search-only organizer material specifies Christiansborg, but that detail is not body-verified.

organizer.summary: Post-event report names several environmental organizations in the organizing group.

demand.summary: Report says march aimed to urge Danish politicians on the nature and biodiversity crisis. Search-only organizer text describes a biodiversity law and 30% protection goals, but these specifics are not body-verified here.

participants.summary: No participant count in body-read S005. Search-only S004 preview claims >5,000; this is not used as an observed count.

threshold_50.summary: Threshold remains pending: S005 establishes gathering but no body-read size; S004 count is search-only and tool could not open the page.

notes: Occurrence and state-directed nature claim have body evidence from post-event commentary; crowd threshold does not. Search-result preview of organizer press release is preserved but not accepted as proof. Demand category left empty because nature-policy demand does not map cleanly to the limited documented taxonomy.
open_questions: A body-read attendance estimate is required to establish the 50-person threshold.
End time and any police response are not known.

title: Aarhus Pride parade
location: Aarhus; parade from Bispetorv through Strøget
scope: Single local Pride procession; kept separate from Copenhagen Pride in August and Aalborg Pride in July.
threshold_50_evidence: AarhusInside body describes an actual street procession with around 12,000 participants.

start_date.summary: AarhusInside published on 25 June and describes a completed Pride parade; exact day is not in the body. LGBT+Huset search result says 24 June, but remains search-only; month-level date is retained.

end_date.summary: No exact end date/time beyond the event described in the June 25 report.

location.summary: Aarhus procession from Bispetorv up Strøget.

organizer.summary: Not clearly identified in opened article.

demand.summary: Feature describes equal-rights, inclusion and diversity message, but does not identify a direct demand to Danish government or state policy.

participants.summary: AarhusInside reports around 12,000 participants; approximate, not exact.

threshold_50.summary: Reported ~12,000 participants and visible public street parade clearly exceed 50.

notes: The source establishes a large public parade and rights/inclusion message, but not that participants were making a demand of the Danish state. Do not infer state targeting from broad equal-rights language. Exact event day is only search-only and not used; month-level start is retained from contemporary past-tense report.
open_questions: Did the parade or organizers direct any specific demand to the Danish government or public authority?
What was the exact start date and organizer?
